edits.name: 白发脉冲 · 向前看
edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve.
Input role: Image 1 is the only edit target and authoritative original. This is a SMALL GAZE/HEAD-DIRECTION CORRECTION, not a new drawing or character redesign.
Primary request: The person is walking toward screen-right. Make their face and eyes look STRAIGHT AHEAD along that walking direction, horizontally toward the right edge of the canvas, NOT toward the camera or the viewer. Turn the face from its current viewer-facing three-quarter angle to a natural clear right-facing near-profile. The visible pupil must sit toward the forward/right side of the eye aperture, aligned with the direction of the nose. The far eye may be naturally mostly hidden by the new head angle; do not draw a face staring out of the picture. Gaze is horizontal, not at the ground and not upward.
Expression: preserve the original cool, aloof, half-lidded expression, dark upper eyelid and confident eyebrow shape. No smile, no newly wide eyes, no surprise, no friendly cute expression, no eye contact with viewer, no sunglasses or glasses. Preserve original mouth presence/absence; do not invent a mouth.
Absolute invariants: edit only the eyes and the minimum necessary face/head rotation. Keep the same character identity, skin tone, hair style/colors/volume, head position/scale, neck position, torso angle, exact walking stance, both arm/hand and foot placements, clothing/accessories, folds, colors, ink linework, cel shading, ground contact shadows, image framing and overall scale. Do not rotate the torso or change the gait. No new elements. Keep the camera strictly eye-level.
Output: exactly one full-body corrected character in the SAME square 1254x1254 canvas as the original, genuinely transparent PNG alpha background. No opaque background or baked checkerboard, no text, watermark, borders or extra character.
Preserve the white spiky cropped hair with the upward cowlick, burnt-coral skin, ivory/black/teal jacket, black shorts, ribbed ivory socks and steel-blue sneakers. Keep the currently mouthless face mouthless; allow a small natural nose silhouette facing screen-right.
